Dimensions of ICF
ICF 分類系統維度
• Health Conditions 健康狀況
• Disease: a known or identifiable cause, such as a virus, bacteria, genetic mutation, or other
biological malfunction
• 疾病: 已知的醫學診斷結果(疾病名稱), 例如病毒, 細菌, 基因突變, 或其他生物學不正常
• Contextual Factors 背景因素
• Personal factors: gender, age, coping styles, social background, education, experience,
characters…
• Environmental factors: external physical / social factors (e.g. stairs, slopes, caregiver, employer,
etc.
• 個人因素: 性別, 年齡, 應對策略, 社會背景, 教育, 經驗, 性格…
• 環境因素: 外在物理性 / 社會性因素 (例 樓梯, 斜路, 照顧者, 顧主, 等)
